slides.title: Rolling 7-Day [[Average]]
slides.note: Jaise share market ka 7-day moving average 📊

slides.title: Sample Table: [[sales]]
slides.note: Daily sales data table jisme amount stored hai

slides.title: Interview Wali [[Query]]
slides.code:
SELECT dt, amt,
  AVG(amt) OVER (
    ORDER BY dt
    ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING
    AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS roll_avg
FROM sales;
slides.note: Pichle 6 din aur aaj ko mila kar average 🚀

slides.title: Clause By [[Clause]]
slides.note: Bole toh: 7 din ki range ka window frame 🪟

slides.title: Exact [[Result]]
slides.note: Pehle din 1 row, doosre din 2 rows ka avg ⚡

slides.right: AVG(amt) OVER (ORDER BY dt ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
slides.why: Bina ROWS BETWEEN ke default frame poora lifetime average nikal deta hai ⚠️
